messages:
morgan: Heads up — running into a nasty onboarding snag with the JS SDK + Expo quickstart. Fresh app, follow quickstart, then `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` and the pack fails during dev on iOS with a TypeError from the runtime about readable streams.

morgan: Steps to repro:
1) `npx create-expo-app my-app`
2) `yarn add @redwood/inference react-native-get-random-values`
3) in App.tsx `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`
4) `expo start` -> crash in Metro with stack trace: `TypeError: undefined is not a function (near '...ReadableStream.prototype.getReader...')`

morgan: Also seeing cryptic failures when using ESM build of SDK vs CJS. Metro picks ESM, then `globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues` ends up missing despite polyfill. :confused:

ash (ash): @morgan thanks for the clear repro. I think two things colliding: Expo/Metro defaults to ESM resolution + our package exposes `module` field and a node/web stream polyfill expectation. Edge runtimes also need a `ReadableStream` shim. Quick workaround: force Metro to resolve to the CJS entry and add `react-native-get-random-values` before any SDK imports. In `metro.config.js` add: 

```js
resolver: {
  sourceExts: ['cjs', 'js', 'ts', 'tsx', 'json'],
  extraNodeModules: { 'stream': require.resolve('readable-stream') }
}
```

ash: Also in App.tsx: `import 'react-native-get-random-values'; import Redwood from '@redwood/inference/dist/cjs'` — that makes the app run for me locally. Not ideal but narrows root cause. :thumbsup:

kai: Re: edge runtime note — our edge-compatible bundle expects WHATWG streams and `ReadableStream` to be present. RN's JSCore (Hermes) only recently landed some stream bits. If the bundler picks ESM that rails toward browser entrypoints, we get a mismatch. We should probably publish a `react-native` specific entry in package.json (exports field) and add a tiny polyfill loader.

samera: I hit a different but related flaky auth thing — when the SDK retries auth on a 401, the retry uses fetch streaming and the body becomes an empty stream in RN, leading to double auth calls and a broken state in our SDK's token refresh logic. I have a minimal failing test in the sample app. cc @ash

ash: Ugh. That explains some product reports. For immediate mitigation I'm going to cut a patch release that: 1) pins the CJS entry for RN, 2) disables streaming-mode for token refresh (fall back to buffered fetch) on platforms without `Response.prototype.body.getReader`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: cut release 0.9.8-rc.1 to npm tag `rn-hotfix` (sha: abc123)

morgan: Trying rc.1 now — after adding `import 'react-native-get-random-values'` and upgrading to `0.9.8-rc.1` the quickstart boots and calls return. Thanks. Still seeing TypeScript typing noise when importing the CJS path in TS projects (tsserver complains about `export default` mismatch).

ash: For typings we can ship a separate `react-native.d.ts` and adjust `types`/`exports` so TS resolves to correct declarations for both the ESM and CJS builds. I'll open a small PR to add `react-native` condition in `exports` and fix `package.json` `types` mapping.

kai: Long-term we'll add a tiny runtime feature-detect at top of the SDK: if running under RN/Hermes, require the RN-specific polyfills and switch transport mode. That avoids forcing consumers to change metro config.

samera: Filed an internal issue with sample-app repro and attached `App.tsx` snippet. Happy to pair on the types PR — I can add a CI job that runs `expo prebuild` + TypeScript check to catch regressions.

morgan: Awesome. Workflows: can we add a note to quickstart docs to include `react-native-get-random-values` until the next stable release? New users will hit this immediately.

ash: Yep — small docs patch incoming. Will also add a FAQ entry: "Expo / Hermes — if you see ReadableStream errors, add polyfill or use RN tag".

samera: :rocket: good ship it.

morgan: Thanks all — marking thread resolved for now, will reopen if any other hiccups show up.
